Introduction

HUNTR/X is a fictional three-member kpop girl group created for the 2025 Netflix animated film KPop Demon Hunters. The group features characters Rumi, Mira, and Zoey, voiced by Arden Cho, May Hong, and Ji-young Yoo respectively. Blending music, fantasy, and action, the film presents HUNTR/X as global superstars who dominate stadium stages by day and fight supernatural forces by night.

Introduced publicly on April 24, 2025, HUNTR/X gained immediate attention following the release of a teaser trailer showcasing the group’s dual life as performers and demon slayers. Their narrative centers on an intense conflict with the Saja Boys, a rival demon boy band disguised as idols whose mission is to eliminate HUNTR/X and absorb their massive fanbase.
